gallery.filename: K2 interior.jpg
gallery.title: File:K2 interior.jpg
gallery.description: Original phone and coin box in a red telephone box outside the Dulwich Picture Gallery. The telephone handset is a GPO type 242. Originally it would have had the more robust braided cable. Coins were inserted in the slots at the top of the adjacent cabinet. When the call was connected you pressed Button A to speak. If the call failed you pressed Button B to get your money returned.
